steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE RS requires you to evaluate different methods of treating criminals — prison, corporal punishment and community service — from Christian and Muslim perspectives. | RS Exam Tips — The Treatment of Criminals: 1. For The Treatment of Criminals questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Treatment of Criminals to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
